prompt.text: We would like to add a text-based trend visualization for each category for the last 3 months. This will help the user see when one category increases or decreases continuously and help them make decisions on whether to adjust. We don't need fancy analysis, just a trend display for each of last 3 months for each category. Since there are several categories, perhaps we can select a few at a time to view, instead of everything in one visualization.

content.message: Entered plan mode. You should now focus on exploring the codebase and designing an implementation approach.

questions.question: What should the text-based trend look like for each selected category?

options.label: Amounts with arrows (Recommended)
options.description: Three months' amounts connected by arrows showing direction month-to-month. Simple, precise, no extra computation beyond comparing consecutive numbers.

options.label: Unicode sparkline bars
options.description: A compact 3-character bar chart (low/med/high block height) plus the amounts, more visual/scannable but a bit more code to scale bar heights.

options.label: Bars + amounts + arrows combined
options.description: Sparkline bars AND arrows AND amounts together — most information-dense, but busiest and closest to "fancy" which you said you didn't need.

questions.question: Where should this trend view live in the app?

options.label: New section on the Categories tab (Recommended)
options.description: Category management, budget-vs-actual, and now trend history all live together where category data is already managed — no new tab needed.

options.label: New section on the Month Summary tab
options.description: Alongside the existing charts/priority lists that already summarize a month's spending, even though this view spans 3 months rather than one.

options.label: A brand-new dedicated tab
options.description: Its own "Trends" tab, separate from both. Cleanest separation, but adds a 6th tab to an already tab-heavy app.

questions.question: Should the 3-month window shift as you navigate months, or always show the latest 3 real calendar months?

options.label: Anchored to the selected month (Recommended)
options.description: The 3 months are the selected month and the two before it — consistent with how the rest of the app (YTD section, category totals) already reacts to the month nav bar.

options.label: Always the latest 3 real calendar months
options.description: Always shows e.g. Jun/Jul/Aug relative to today's actual date, regardless of which month is selected elsewhere in the app.

answers.Where should this trend view live in the: New section on the Categories tab (Recommended)

Clean startup, all 93 tests pass. Implementation complete:

**What was built:**
- `CategoryTrendService` — computes each non-income category's actual spend across 3 months (the selected month and the two before it), reusing `BudgetService.categoryTotals()`.
- **Categories tab**: new "Category Trends (last 3 months)" section with a multi-select list of categories next to a live-updating text panel. Selecting categories renders lines like `Groceries:  Jun $310.00  →  Jul $340.00 ^  →  Aug $290.00 v`, updating immediately as you (de)select, and shifting its 3-month window whenever you navigate months via the nav bar.

**Verified:** `mvn test` — 93/93 pass (4 new tests covering ordering, zero-defaulting for months with no transactions, income-only exclusion, and year-boundary handling); `mvn javafx:run` — clean startup against real data.
